checks.name: Inspection, preview and raw export never write game values or durable journals
Foreign, cancelled and unacknowledged plans cannot replace real game values
Selected game groups restore exact raw bytes only after a durable before/after journal exists
An interrupted write before cursor confirmation is resumed idempotently by a new restorer
Explicit undo after a completed restore survives a new page instance and preserves raw whitespace
Outside changes block both resume and undo without overwriting another writer
Journal quota failure prevents the first game write; storage quota retains a recoverable journal
Damaged journal SHA, unsupported storage keys and duplicate JSON keys are rejected before writes
Web Locks denial, stale previews and aborts cannot silently commit another restore
Delayed IndexedDB opening, page close/resume and version changes never reuse a closed connection
The replay gateway separates R28 from R7/R13 and refuses unknown evolution contracts or duplicate JSON

scope: Real allowlisted game values in isolated memory fixtures; durable journal/real browser storage, reload and opaque replay source verification are tested separately in the browser suite. No cloud or physical-device recovery certification.
